preparation_constraints: No questions are authored in this change.
Preparation invokes no retriever, embedder, generator, bootstrap or metric evaluation; v3 questions and metrics are neither run nor configured in this change.
Retrieval, context, corpus sources, baselines and CI configuration remain unchanged.
No v3 metric is added to CI; existing development checks remain unchanged.
v1-011 remains unfixed, including its existing strict expected-failure marker.

initial_transfers.reason: preceding quota group has fewer eligible chunks than its demanded quota

authoring.replacement_policy: first unused same-group reserve; if exhausted, first unused reserve in the next downstream group with reserves; no wraparound; log all skips, replacements and transfers
authoring.transfer_record: all initial transfers in allocation_transfers; all author-time cross-group transfers in authoring_transfers, with authoring_events and final quotas updated in sample.json
authoring.all_relevant_sections: plain-text search across all 21 files; include every section explicitly stating any key fact; their union must cover all key facts
authoring.cluster_key: documentation group equals the accepted source chunk section_id, not an author topic or file
author_restrictions: plain text search only; no other programs
no earlier datasets, results, memories or conversations as factual sources

freeze_before_evaluation: Validate 72 unique sequential IDs and the exact 60/4/3/3/2 category counts without retrieval.
Validate unique accepted documentation chunks, 6-18-word questions, one or two facts, verbatim passage evidence, valid section labels, author search notes and every replacement/transfer.
Record final SHA256 hashes of questions.jsonl, AUTHOR-NOTES.md and sample.json, plus this protocol's commit, before any v3 retrieval output is seen.
Verify the corpus and frozen retrieval/context/runtime files still match this protocol. Do not change labels or configuration after the run starts.

postgres_fts.implementation: unchanged PostgresRetriever(method=fts); English stemming, not BM25

embedding.query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

scope_gate.test_only_runner_requirement: use this stored threshold explicitly; do not call the existing CLI in a way that recalibrates on test-only questions

evaluation.execution_failure: persist completed query outputs and disclose partial/failed execution; do not silently rerun a scored query or discard an unfavorable outcome

scoring.retrieval_population: exactly the 60 documentation questions; equal question weight; non-documentation excluded
scoring.ranking_unit: deduplicate section IDs in returned-chunk order, keeping first occurrence; top k means first k distinct sections
scoring.relevance: binary relevance against the complete authored relevant_sections union; no gains for repeated chunks from one section

primary.estimate: mean over 60 questions of |top5_sections intersect relevant_sections| / |relevant_sections|
primary.interval: section-cluster bootstrap percentile 95%, 10000 resamples, fixed seed 20261106

secondary.mrr@10: mean reciprocal first relevant distinct-section rank within 10, zero if absent
secondary.ndcg@5: binary DCG with 1/log2(rank+1), divided by ideal DCG for min(5, number of relevant sections)
secondary.hit@1: mean indicator that a relevant section is ranked first
secondary.hit@5: mean indicator that any relevant section occurs among five distinct sections
secondary.raw_five_chunk_coverage: mean relevant-section recall from the first five raw chunks, before section deduplication or expansion
secondary.expanded_context_coverage: mean relevant-section recall from the actual document chunk IDs provided by the unchanged expanded answer path; record chunk count and serialized bytes too

scoring.rounding: retain full per-question precision through aggregation/bootstrap; round only display values

report: expected versus predicted route per question
refused flag and reason per question
route accuracy overall and by category
non_documentation.expected_refusal: all 12 under the documentation-answer evaluation path
non_documentation.limits: fake results test routing/refusal plumbing, not real-model factual quality, comprehensive injection resistance or live API behavior

uncertainty.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64(20261106)), independently initialized for question and cluster procedures; same resampling indices reused across methods/metrics
uncertainty.ordering: sort documentation IDs; sort unique source-section group IDs; retain all questions within each group
uncertainty.question_bootstrap: sample 60 question IDs with replacement; preserve paired method scores for every sampled ID
uncertainty.section_cluster_bootstrap: sample G source-section group IDs with replacement, G equal to the number of observed groups; include every member of each sampled group with multiplicity; compute the question-weighted mean over the resulting variable-size sample
uncertainty.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles with linear interpolation; no score rounding before percentiles

paired_comparisons.statistic: mean per-question hybrid-minus-comparator difference, using the same paired question/cluster draw for both methods
paired_comparisons.zero_rule: if an interval includes zero (inclusive), report 'no detectable difference' for that interval; describe a consistent direction only when both paired procedures exclude zero in the same direction
paired_comparisons.multiplicity: 95% intervals are unadjusted descriptive comparisons, not family-wise confirmatory significance tests

reporting: Publish all methods and all prespecified metrics regardless of outcome; no winner-only reporting.
Report primary section-cluster CI, section/group count and sizes, final file quotas, substitutions and any incomplete slots.
Report both paired interval procedures for every contrast/metric, including intervals containing zero.
Disclose shortfall transfers, author declarations/departures, code/corpus/question hashes and execution failures.
Do not present previous-corpus holdout results as current-corpus measurements; do not tune after this run.
Document that source-quota sampling and synthetic operator wording limit generalization; section clustering handles within-section dependence, not every possible source of dependence.
Log the later single evaluation's protocol/question/corpus/config hashes and raw per-question outputs in MLflow; no experiment is run during preparation.
